decision_conditions: The information submitted in respect of discharging condition 26 (Piling Method Statement) is considered insufficient and inadequate, with the information provided failing to demonstrate that proposed piling would not cause damage to subsurface sewerage infrastructure. The details provided are thereby considered unacceptable and contrary to Policies CP21 and CP32 of the Core Strategy (2010), DMD 62 of the Development Management Document (2014), Policy SI 5 of the London Plan (2021), and the NPPF (2024).
description: Details submitted pursuant to appeal reference APP/Q5300/W/22/3300255 (21/01248/FUL): piling method statement (26) and full fibre connectivity (33) in respect of demolition of existing public house (sui-generis) and construction of part 3, part 4, part 5 storey residential building (Class C3) with ground floor public house (Use Class E / Sui-generis) and associated cycle and car parking, refuse storage and external landscaping.
